events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential implications for global oil supplies and geopolitical stability. The situation is being closely monitored by investors and policymakers. The conflict may lead to increased volatility in the oil market and potentially impact the global economy.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict may lead to increased oil prices, which could impact the global economy. Investors are advised to buy the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) as a hedge against potential market volatility, while shorting the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) to capitalize on potential declines in oil prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor news and adjust position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit position if conflict de-escalates or oil prices stabilize
